examples.en: I usually have eggs and bacon for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我通常早餐吃蛋和培根。

examples.en: The smell of frying bacon made my mouth water.
examples.zh: 煎培根的香味讓我垂涎三尺。

examples.en: He added some crispy bacon to the salad.
examples.zh: 他在沙拉裡加了一些酥脆的培根。

examples.en: I ordered a bacon and cheese sandwich for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐點了一份培根起司三明治。

examples.en: Eating too much bacon is not good for your health.
examples.zh: 吃太多培根對你的健康不好。

examples.en: The barber trimmed my hair perfectly.
examples.zh: 理髮師把我的頭髮修剪得很完美。

examples.en: He goes to the same barber every month.
examples.zh: 他每個月都去同一位理髮師那裡剪頭髮。

examples.en: There is a new barber shop around the corner.
examples.zh: 轉角處新開了一家理髮店。

examples.en: The barber chatted with his customer while shaving his beard.
examples.zh: 理髮師在幫客人刮鬍子時與他聊天。

examples.en: My father learned to cut hair from an experienced barber.
examples.zh: 我父親向一位經驗豐富的理髮師學習剪髮。

examples.en: The light bulb in the living room has burned out.
examples.zh: 客廳的電燈泡燒壞了。

examples.en: We planted tulip bulbs in the garden last autumn.
examples.zh: 我們去年秋天在花園裡種了鬱金香的球莖。

examples.en: Please change the bulb before it gets too dark.
examples.zh: 請在天色變暗之前換一下燈泡。

examples.en: These energy-saving bulbs last much longer than the old ones.
examples.zh: 這些節能燈泡比舊的耐用得多。

examples.en: The room went dark suddenly when the bulb shattered.
examples.zh: 燈泡碎裂時，房間瞬間變暗了。

examples.en: They spent their weekend in a cozy log cabin in the woods.
examples.zh: 他們在森林裡一間舒適的小木屋度過了週末。

examples.en: The passengers were told to stay in the cabin during the storm.
examples.zh: 乘客被告知在暴風雨期間要留在船艙內。

examples.en: Cabin crew, please prepare for landing.
examples.zh: 機組人員，請準備降落。

examples.en: The pilot announced that the cabin pressure was normal.
examples.zh: 機長宣布機艙壓力正常。

examples.en: We rented a small cabin near the lake for our summer vacation.
examples.zh: 我們租了一間湖畔的小木屋度暑假。

examples.en: Smoke was rising slowly from the chimney.
examples.zh: 煙緩緩從煙囪中升起。

examples.en: Santa Claus is said to come down the chimney to deliver gifts.
examples.zh: 據說聖誕老人會從煙囪下來送禮物。

examples.en: The old factory has a tall brick chimney.
examples.zh: 這家舊工廠有一根高大的磚造煙囪。

examples.en: The strong wind blew down the chimney of the old house.
examples.zh: 強風吹倒了老房子的煙囪。

examples.en: Birds sometimes build their nests near the warm chimney.
examples.zh: 鳥兒有時會在溫暖的煙囪附近築巢。

examples.en: She used a hair clip to keep her hair out of her face.
examples.zh: 她用髮夾把頭髮夾住，以免遮到臉。

examples.en: Please clip these documents together.
examples.zh: 請把這些文件夾在一起。

examples.en: He clipped a short article from the morning newspaper.
examples.zh: 他從晨報上剪下了一篇短文。

examples.en: The teacher used a paper clip to hold the test papers together.
examples.zh: 老師用迴紋針把考卷夾在一起。

examples.en: He was watching a short video clip on his smartphone.
examples.zh: 他正在智慧型手機上看一段短片。

examples.en: The word 'apple' is a countable noun.
examples.zh: 「蘋果」這個字是可數名詞。

examples.en: You should use 'many' with countable items.
examples.zh: 你應該將 'many' 用在可數的物品上。

examples.en: Countable things can be easily quantified.
examples.zh: 可數的事物可以輕易地被量化。

examples.en: In English, 'furniture' is an uncountable noun, while 'chair' is a countable one.
examples.zh: 在英文中，'furniture'是不可數名詞，而'chair'是可數名詞。

examples.en: Are there any countable benefits to this new policy?
examples.zh: 這項新政策有任何具體可數的益處嗎？

examples.en: The little girl believes that fairies live in the garden.
examples.zh: 小女孩相信花園裡住著仙子。

examples.en: She dressed up as a beautiful fairy for the costume party.
examples.zh: 她在化妝舞會上打扮成美麗的仙子。

examples.en: The tooth fairy left a coin under his pillow.
examples.zh: 牙仙子在他的枕頭底下留了一枚硬幣。

examples.en: The story is about a young boy who befriends a magical fairy.
examples.zh: 這個故事講述一個小男孩與一位神奇仙子做朋友的經歷。

examples.en: She bought a beautiful fairy costume for Halloween.
examples.zh: 她為萬聖節買了一套美麗的仙子服裝。

examples.en: My mother used to read me fairy tales before bedtime.
examples.zh: 我小時候，媽媽總會在睡前念童話故事給我聽。

examples.en: Not every fairy tale has a happy ending.
examples.zh: 並非所有的童話故事都有快樂的結局。

examples.en: Their love story is like a beautiful fairy tale.
examples.zh: 他們的愛情故事就像一個美麗的童話。

examples.en: The movie is based on a classic German fairy tale.
examples.zh: 這部電影改編自經典的德國童話故事。

examples.en: Sometimes reality is much more complex than a fairy tale.
examples.zh: 有時現實比童話故事複雜得多。

examples.en: We watched the spectacular fireworks light up the night sky.
examples.zh: 我們觀看壯觀的煙火照亮夜空。

examples.en: They are going to set off fireworks on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 他們打算在跨年夜施放煙火。

examples.en: The firework display was the highlight of the festival.
examples.zh: 煙火秀是這個節慶的最高潮。

examples.en: The city government spent millions on the National Day fireworks.
examples.zh: 市政府在國慶煙火上花費了數百萬。

examples.en: The loud bang of the firework scared the dog.
examples.zh: 煙火巨大的爆炸聲嚇到了那隻狗。

examples.en: Always keep a first-aid kit in your car for emergencies.
examples.zh: 車上要隨時準備一個急救箱以備不時之需。

examples.en: The hiker quickly pulled out his first-aid kit to treat the wound.
examples.zh: 這名登山客迅速拿出急救箱來處理傷口。

examples.en: We need to restock the supplies in our first-aid kit.
examples.zh: 我們需要補充急救箱裡的用品。

examples.en: The school nurse took a bandage from the first-aid kit.
examples.zh: 學校護理師從急救箱裡拿出一塊繃帶。

examples.en: Every home should have a well-stocked first-aid kit.
examples.zh: 每個家庭都應該準備一個物品齊全的急救箱。

examples.en: The engine consumes about a gallon of fuel every ten miles.
examples.zh: 這具引擎每十英里大約消耗一加侖的燃料。

examples.en: He drank nearly half a gallon of water after the marathon.
examples.zh: 馬拉松比賽後，他喝了將近半加侖的水。

examples.en: Milk is usually sold by the gallon in this country.
examples.zh: 在這個國家，牛奶通常以加侖為單位販售。

examples.en: He bought two gallons of paint to decorate his bedroom.
examples.zh: 他買了兩加侖的油漆來裝飾他的臥室。

examples.en: The car gets about thirty miles to the gallon.
examples.zh: 這輛車每加侖大約能跑三十英里。

examples.en: The doctor's gentle voice calmed the crying child.
examples.zh: 醫生溫和的聲音安撫了哭泣的孩子。

examples.en: You need to be very gentle when handling these fragile glasses.
examples.zh: 處理這些易碎的玻璃杯時，你需要非常輕柔。

examples.en: A gentle breeze blew across the lake.
examples.zh: 一陣微風輕拂過湖面。

examples.en: The nurse was very gentle when giving the injection.
examples.zh: 護理師打針時非常溫柔。

examples.en: A gentle touch on the shoulder gave him a lot of comfort.
examples.zh: 肩膀上溫柔的觸碰給了他許多安慰。

examples.en: Tomatoes can be grown in a greenhouse throughout the winter.
examples.zh: 番茄可以在溫室裡種植一整個冬天。

examples.en: The temperature inside the greenhouse is carefully controlled.
examples.zh: 溫室內的溫度受到嚴格控制。

examples.en: She built a small greenhouse in her backyard to grow rare orchids.
examples.zh: 她在後院建了一個小溫室來種植珍稀的蘭花。

examples.en: Plants grow faster in a greenhouse because of the trapped heat.
examples.zh: 植物在溫室裡因為熱量被困住而生長得更快。

examples.en: The university built a large greenhouse for agricultural research.
examples.zh: 大學建造了一個大型溫室用於農業研究。

examples.en: The greenhouse effect is causing global temperatures to rise.
examples.zh: 溫室效應導致全球氣溫上升。

examples.en: Carbon dioxide plays a major role in the greenhouse effect.
examples.zh: 二氧化碳在溫室效應中扮演了主要角色。

examples.en: Scientists have warned us about the dangers of the greenhouse effect for decades.
examples.zh: 數十來年，科學家一直警告我們溫室效應的危險。

examples.en: Reducing carbon emissions can help slow down the greenhouse effect.
examples.zh: 減少碳排放有助於減緩溫室效應。

examples.en: The greenhouse effect traps the sun's heat in the Earth's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 溫室效應將太陽的熱量困在地球大氣層中。

examples.en: You look completely different with your new haircut.
examples.zh: 你剪了新髮型後看起來完全不一樣了。

examples.en: I think it's time for you to get a haircut.
examples.zh: 我覺得你該去理髮了。

examples.en: His haircut is very trendy right now.
examples.zh: 他的髮型現在非常流行。

examples.en: I went to the salon to get a haircut before the job interview.
examples.zh: 我在面試前去髮廊剪了頭髮。

examples.en: His terrible haircut made him the laughingstock of the class.
examples.zh: 他那糟糕的髮型讓他成了班上的笑柄。

examples.en: My hairdresser advised me not to dye my hair too often.
examples.zh: 我的美髮師建議我不要太常染髮。

examples.en: She has worked as a hairdresser for over twenty years.
examples.zh: 她已經當了超過二十年的美髮師。

examples.en: You should ask your hairdresser to recommend a good shampoo.
examples.zh: 你應該請你的美髮師推薦一款好用的洗髮精。

examples.en: The hairdresser styled her hair beautifully for the prom.
examples.zh: 美髮師為她的舞會做了一個漂亮的髮型。

examples.en: A good hairdresser knows exactly what look suits their client best.
examples.zh: 一位優秀的美髮師非常清楚什麼造型最適合他們的客戶。

examples.en: She likes to try a new hairstyle every few months.
examples.zh: 她喜歡每隔幾個月就嘗試一種新髮型。

examples.en: That vintage hairstyle suits her face perfectly.
examples.zh: 那種復古髮型非常適合她的臉型。

examples.en: What kind of hairstyle are you looking for today?
examples.zh: 你今天想做什麼樣的髮型呢？

examples.en: She flipped through a magazine to find a trendy hairstyle.
examples.zh: 她翻閱雜誌尋找時髦的髮型。

examples.en: Changing your hairstyle is an easy way to refresh your look.
examples.zh: 改變髮型是煥然一新的簡單方法。

examples.en: The eggs take about three weeks to hatch.
examples.zh: 這些蛋大約需要三個星期才能孵化。

examples.en: They hatched a secret plan to surprise him on his birthday.
examples.zh: 他們策劃了一個祕密計畫，要在他的生日給他驚喜。

examples.en: All the baby chicks hatched safely yesterday.
examples.zh: 所有的小雞昨天都平安孵化了。

examples.en: The tiny turtles hatched and immediately crawled toward the ocean.
examples.zh: 小海龜孵化後立刻爬向海洋。

examples.en: They hatched a plot to overthrow the current government.
examples.zh: 他們策劃了一場推翻現任政府的陰謀。

examples.en: The squirrel hid its nuts inside a hollow tree.
examples.zh: 松鼠把堅果藏在空心的樹幹裡。

examples.en: His promises sounded hollow and insincere.
examples.zh: 他的承諾聽起來很虛偽且不真誠。

examples.en: When tapped, the wall made a hollow sound.
examples.zh: 敲擊時，這面牆發出了空洞的聲音。

examples.en: The owl made its nest inside the hollow trunk of an old oak.
examples.zh: 貓頭鷹在一棵老橡樹的空心樹幹裡築巢。

examples.en: His apology rang hollow because he repeated the same mistake.
examples.zh: 他的道歉顯得十分虛偽，因為他又犯了同樣的錯誤。

examples.en: They hired a housekeeper to take care of the large mansion.
examples.zh: 他們僱用了一位管家來打理這棟豪宅。

examples.en: The housekeeper ensures that everything in the house is perfectly clean.
examples.zh: 管家確保屋裡的每樣東西都非常乾淨。

examples.en: She has been working as a housekeeper for the wealthy family for years.
examples.zh: 她已經在這戶富裕人家當管家好幾年了。

examples.en: The hotel housekeeper changed the bed sheets and provided fresh towels.
examples.zh: 飯店房務員更換了床單並提供了乾淨的毛巾。

examples.en: We need an honest housekeeper to manage our daily chores.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位誠實的管家來處理日常家務。

examples.en: She gave her mother a tight hug before leaving.
examples.zh: 離開前，她緊緊擁抱了母親。

examples.en: The little boy hugged his teddy bear and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 小男孩抱著他的泰迪熊睡著了。

examples.en: They hugged each other when they heard the good news.
examples.zh: 聽到好消息時，他們互相擁抱。

examples.en: They exchanged a warm hug at the airport before parting ways.
examples.zh: 他們在機場分道揚鑣前給了彼此一個溫暖的擁抱。

examples.en: The frightened puppy hugged my leg and refused to let go.
examples.zh: 那隻受驚的小狗緊緊抱住我的腿不肯放開。

examples.en: The hermit lives in a small wooden hut in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這位隱士住在山上的一間木造小屋裡。

examples.en: They sought shelter from the rain in an abandoned hut.
examples.zh: 他們在一間廢棄的棚屋裡避雨。

examples.en: The village consists of a dozen mud huts.
examples.zh: 這個村莊由十幾個泥草屋組成。

examples.en: The fishermen built a simple hut on the beach to store their gear.
examples.zh: 漁夫們在海灘上建了一個簡陋的小屋來存放裝備。

examples.en: We found an empty hut deep in the forest during our hike.
examples.zh: 在健行期間，我們在森林深處發現了一間空無一人的棚屋。

examples.en: We saw a kangaroo hopping across the road in Australia.
examples.zh: 在澳洲，我們看到一隻袋鼠跳過馬路。

examples.en: The mother kangaroo carries her baby in her pouch.
examples.zh: 母袋鼠把寶寶裝在育兒袋裡。

examples.en: Kangaroos can leap incredible distances with their powerful hind legs.
examples.zh: 袋鼠能用強壯的後腿跳躍驚人的距離。

examples.en: The cartoon featured a boxing kangaroo with giant gloves.
examples.zh: 這部卡通裡有一隻戴著巨大手套的拳擊袋鼠。

examples.en: Kangaroos use their thick tails for balance when hopping.
examples.zh: 袋鼠在跳躍時利用粗壯的尾巴來保持平衡。

examples.en: He bought a tool kit to repair his bicycle.
examples.zh: 他買了一個工具箱來修理腳踏車。

examples.en: The model airplane comes as a kit that you assemble yourself.
examples.zh: 這架模型飛機是成套裝備，需要你自己組裝。

examples.en: Don't forget your sewing kit if a button falls off.
examples.zh: 如果扣子掉了，別忘了你的針線包。

examples.en: The emergency survival kit includes a flashlight and some rations.
examples.zh: 緊急求生包裡包含一個手電筒和一些口糧。

examples.en: He bought a drum kit and practiced playing it every evening.
examples.zh: 他買了一套爵士鼓，並在每天傍晚練習。

examples.en: The koala was sleeping peacefully on a eucalyptus branch.
examples.zh: 這隻無尾熊在尤加利樹枝上安詳地睡著。

examples.en: Koalas feed mainly on eucalyptus leaves.
examples.zh: 無尾熊主要以尤加利葉為食。

examples.en: We took a lot of pictures of the adorable koala at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園拍了許多那隻可愛無尾熊的照片。

examples.en: The koala's thick fur keeps it warm during cold nights.
examples.zh: 無尾熊厚實的毛皮能讓牠在寒冷的夜晚保暖。

examples.en: Habitat loss is a major threat to the survival of the koala.
examples.zh: 棲息地喪失是無尾熊生存的一大威脅。

examples.en: Please write your name on the label.
examples.zh: 請在標籤上寫下你的名字。

examples.en: I labeled all the boxes so we know what's inside.
examples.zh: 我給所有箱子都貼了標籤，這樣我們就知道裡面裝了什麼。

examples.en: The price is printed on the label attached to the shirt.
examples.zh: 價格印在附在襯衫上的標籤上。

examples.en: Please carefully read the label on the medicine bottle before taking it.
examples.zh: 服用前請仔細閱讀藥瓶上的標籤。

examples.en: The media unfairly labeled him as a troublemaker.
examples.zh: 媒體不公平地將他貼上麻煩製造者的標籤。

examples.en: Her wedding dress was decorated with delicate lace.
examples.zh: 她的婚紗裝飾著精緻的蕾絲。

examples.en: Your shoe lace is untied; be careful not to trip.
examples.zh: 你的鞋帶鬆了；小心別絆倒。

examples.en: He bought a beautifully crafted lace tablecloth.
examples.zh: 他買了一條做工精美的蕾絲桌布。

examples.en: Her vintage dress featured delicate lace around the collar.
examples.zh: 她的復古洋裝領口周圍有精緻的蕾絲。

examples.en: He stooped down to tie his shoelace before the race started.
examples.zh: 比賽開始前，他彎下腰來綁鞋帶。

examples.en: I go to the laundromat every Sunday to wash my clothes.
examples.zh: 我每個星期天都去自助洗衣店洗衣服。

examples.en: The laundromat on the corner is open 24 hours a day.
examples.zh: 轉角那間自助洗衣店24小時營業。

examples.en: He read a magazine while waiting for his clothes at the laundromat.
examples.zh: 他在自助洗衣店等衣服時看了一本雜誌。

examples.en: I forgot my detergent, so I had to buy some at the laundromat.
examples.zh: 我忘了帶洗衣精，只好在自助洗衣店買一些。

examples.en: The old laundromat was closed down and replaced by a cafe.
examples.zh: 那間舊的自助洗衣店倒閉了，取而代之的是一間咖啡館。

examples.en: It is your turn to do the laundry this week.
examples.zh: 這個星期輪到你洗衣服了。

examples.en: The laundry basket is full of dirty clothes.
examples.zh: 洗衣籃裡裝滿了髒衣服。

examples.en: She hung the clean laundry out to dry in the sun.
examples.zh: 她把洗好的乾淨衣服晾在外面曬太陽。

examples.en: She sorted the laundry into whites and colors before washing.
examples.zh: 她在洗衣服前將衣物分為白色和彩色。

examples.en: I have to do the laundry this weekend because I've run out of clean shirts.
examples.zh: 這週末我必須洗衣服，因為我已經沒有乾淨的襯衫了。

examples.en: The pipe under the sink started to leak.
examples.zh: 水槽底下的水管開始漏水了。

examples.en: We must fix the leak in the roof before it rains.
examples.zh: 我們必須在下雨前修好屋頂的漏洞。

examples.en: Someone leaked the secret information to the press.
examples.zh: 有人將機密資訊洩漏給了新聞界。

examples.en: The plumber came to fix a severe leak in our bathroom.
examples.zh: 水電工來修理我們浴室裡嚴重的漏水問題。

examples.en: The company fired the employee who leaked the confidential report.
examples.zh: 公司開除了那位洩漏機密報告的員工。

meaning: 磁鐵；有吸引力的人或物

examples.en: She stuck the note to the refrigerator with a magnet.
examples.zh: 她用一塊磁鐵把紙條貼在冰箱上。

examples.en: The new shopping mall is a magnet for teenagers.
examples.zh: 這家新開幕的購物中心對青少年非常有吸引力。

examples.en: Iron is easily attracted to a magnet.
examples.zh: 鐵很容易被磁鐵吸引。

examples.en: The strong magnet easily picked up the scattered nails.
examples.zh: 這塊強力磁鐵輕鬆吸起了散落的釘子。

examples.en: The beautiful scenery makes this town a magnet for tourists.
examples.zh: 美麗的風景使這個小鎮對遊客極具吸引力。

examples.en: Could you lend me your nail clipper? My nail is broken.
examples.zh: 可以借我你的指甲剪嗎？我的指甲斷了。

examples.en: He used a nail clipper to trim his fingernails neatly.
examples.zh: 他用指甲剪把手指甲修剪得整整齊齊。

examples.en: Always clean your nail clippers after using them.
examples.zh: 使用後務必清潔你的指甲剪。

examples.en: I couldn't find my nail clipper, so I had to use small scissors.
examples.zh: 我找不到我的指甲剪，只好用小剪刀。

examples.en: The hotel provided complimentary toiletries, including a tiny nail clipper.
examples.zh: 飯店提供了免費的盥洗用品，包括一把小小的指甲剪。

examples.en: The giant panda is native to central China.
examples.zh: 大貓熊原產於中國中部。

examples.en: We stood in line for hours just to see the baby panda.
examples.zh: 我們排了幾個小時的隊，就為了看熊貓寶寶。

examples.en: Pandas spend most of their day eating bamboo.
examples.zh: 貓熊每天大部分的時間都在吃竹子。

examples.en: The panda slowly munched on bamboo shoots in the enclosure.
examples.zh: 貓熊在圍欄裡慢慢咀嚼著竹筍。

examples.en: The birth of the twin pandas was celebrated all over the country.
examples.zh: 全國上下都在慶祝這對雙胞胎貓熊的誕生。

examples.en: The mountain peak was covered with snow all year round.
examples.zh: 這座山頂終年被白雪覆蓋。

examples.en: Traffic is always terrible during the peak hours.
examples.zh: 尖峰時段的交通總是糟透了。

examples.en: The singer's career reached its peak in the late 90s.
examples.zh: 這位歌手的事業在90年代末達到頂峰。

examples.en: The hikers were exhausted when they finally reached the peak.
examples.zh: 登山客最終抵達山頂時已經筋疲力盡了。

examples.en: The hotel rates are much higher during the peak season.
examples.zh: 飯店的房價在旺季時高出許多。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful necklace made of real pearls.
examples.zh: 她戴了一條由真珍珠製成的美麗項鍊。

examples.en: The diver found a shiny pearl inside the oyster.
examples.zh: 潛水員在牡蠣裡發現了一顆閃亮的珍珠。

examples.en: Pearls are often seen as a symbol of purity and elegance.
examples.zh: 珍珠通常被視為純潔和優雅的象徵。

examples.en: She received a pair of elegant pearl earrings for her anniversary.
examples.zh: 她收到了一副優雅的珍珠耳環作為週年紀念禮物。

examples.en: The divers risk their lives searching for precious pearls in the ocean.
examples.zh: 潛水員冒著生命危險在海洋中尋找珍貴的珍珠。

examples.en: He ordered a pint of beer at the pub.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧點了一品脫的啤酒。

examples.en: I bought a pint of milk from the grocery store.
examples.zh: 我從雜貨店買了一品脫的牛奶。

examples.en: She donated a pint of blood to the hospital yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天向醫院捐了一品脫的血。

examples.en: He drank a pint of water to quench his thirst.
examples.zh: 他喝了一品脫的水來解渴。

examples.en: Would you like to join us for a pint after work?
examples.zh: 下班後你想跟我們一起去喝杯啤酒嗎？

examples.en: There is a large movie poster hanging on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上掛著一張巨大的電影海報。

examples.en: The teacher pinned an educational poster to the bulletin board.
examples.zh: 老師把一張具教育意義的海報釘在佈告欄上。

examples.en: They designed a brilliant poster for the upcoming concert.
examples.zh: 他們為即將到來的演唱會設計了一張出色的海報。

examples.en: They printed a thousand posters to promote the school fair.
examples.zh: 他們印了一千張海報來宣傳學校園遊會。

examples.en: Her room is decorated with posters of her favorite pop bands.
examples.zh: 她的房間裡裝飾著她最喜歡的流行樂團的海報。

examples.en: He bought an electric razor to save time in the morning.
examples.zh: 他買了一把電動刮鬍刀以節省早上的時間。

examples.en: The razor is too dull and might cut your skin.
examples.zh: 這把刮鬍刀太鈍了，可能會割傷你的皮膚。

examples.en: Make sure you clean the razor after each use.
examples.zh: 每次使用後，一定要確保把刮鬍刀清洗乾淨。

examples.en: He accidentally cut his chin while shaving with a dull razor.
examples.zh: 他用鈍刮鬍刀刮鬍子時不小心割傷了下巴。

examples.en: The barber used a straight razor to give him a precise shave.
examples.zh: 理髮師用一把直剃刀為他精準地刮鬍子。

examples.en: You should change the razor blade when it stops shaving smoothly.
examples.zh: 當刮起來不順暢時，你就應該更換刮鬍刀片。

examples.en: Be careful when handling a new razor blade; it's extremely sharp.
examples.zh: 拿新刮鬍刀片時要小心，它非常鋒利。

examples.en: He bought a pack of razor blades at the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 他在藥局買了一盒刮鬍刀片。

examples.en: You should dispose of used razor blades safely in a proper container.
examples.zh: 你應該將用過的刮鬍刀片安全地丟棄在合適的容器中。

examples.en: A rusty razor blade can cause a serious infection.
examples.zh: 生鏽的刮鬍刀片可能會引起嚴重的感染。

examples.en: The athlete reached his peak in his mid-twenties.
examples.zh: 這位運動員在二十五歲左右達到了他的巔峰狀態。

examples.en: Her artistic creativity reached its peak during her trip to Europe.
examples.zh: 她的藝術創造力在歐洲旅行期間達到了巔峰。

examples.en: Sales typically reach their peak right before the holidays.
examples.zh: 銷售量通常在假期前夕達到巔峰。

examples.en: The tennis player reached her peak when she won the grand slam.
examples.zh: 這位網球選手在贏得大滿貫時達到了她的巔峰。

examples.en: Economic growth is expected to reach its peak next quarter.
examples.zh: 經濟成長預計將在下個季度達到巔峰。

examples.en: I don't have time to cook, so I bought some ready-made meals.
examples.zh: 我沒時間做飯，所以我買了一些現成的微波食品。

examples.en: He avoids ready-made clothing because it rarely fits him well.
examples.zh: 他盡量不買現成的衣服，因為尺寸很少合身。

examples.en: They used a ready-made template for their website design.
examples.zh: 他們為網站設計使用了一個現成的模板。

examples.en: These ready-made curtains perfectly match the color of my room.
examples.zh: 這些現成的窗簾和我的房間顏色完美搭配。

examples.en: He submitted a ready-made business plan he found online.
examples.zh: 他提交了一份在網路上找到的現成商業企劃書。

examples.en: The magician refused to reveal the secret behind his trick.
examples.zh: 魔術師拒絕透露他戲法背後的祕密。

examples.en: Her facial expression revealed her true feelings.
examples.zh: 她的臉部表情洩漏了她的真實感受。

examples.en: The test results revealed that she was perfectly healthy.
examples.zh: 檢查結果顯示她非常健康。

examples.en: The newspaper revealed the scandal involving the corrupt politician.
examples.zh: 報紙揭露了那位腐敗政客的醜聞。

examples.en: The curtain was drawn back to reveal a magnificent painting.
examples.zh: 拉開窗簾後，展示出一幅宏偉的畫作。

examples.en: We grilled some sausages in the backyard for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐在後院烤了一些香腸。

examples.en: He likes to put mustard and ketchup on his sausage.
examples.zh: 他喜歡在香腸上加芥末醬和番茄醬。

examples.en: The traditional breakfast includes eggs, beans, and a sausage.
examples.zh: 這份傳統早餐包含蛋、豆子和一條香腸。

examples.en: I bought some spicy Italian sausage for tonight's pasta dish.
examples.zh: 我買了一些辣味義大利香腸來做今晚的義大利麵。

examples.en: The factory produces tons of pork sausage every single day.
examples.zh: 這家工廠每天生產數噸的豬肉香腸。

examples.en: The shopkeeper greeted us with a warm smile when we entered.
examples.zh: 我們走進去時，老闆用溫暖的微笑迎接我們。

examples.en: The old shopkeeper knows everyone in this neighborhood.
examples.zh: 這位老店主認識這個社區的每個人。

examples.en: She bargained with the shopkeeper for a better price.
examples.zh: 她跟老闆討價還價，希望能算便宜一點。

examples.en: The shopkeeper chased away the stray dog that entered his store.
examples.zh: 店主把跑進他店裡的流浪狗趕走了。

examples.en: An honest shopkeeper always returns the exact change to his customers.
examples.zh: 誠實的商店老闆總是會找給顧客正確的零錢。

meaning: n. 義大利麵(類似油麵粗細的麵條)

examples.en: I cooked a large pot of spaghetti with meatballs for dinner.
examples.zh: 我晚餐煮了一大鍋肉丸義大利麵。

examples.en: The children love eating spaghetti in tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡吃番茄醬義大利麵。

examples.en: Don't break the spaghetti before boiling it.
examples.zh: 在煮義大利麵之前不要把它折斷。

examples.en: She twirled the spaghetti on her fork like a professional.
examples.zh: 她像個專業人士一樣用叉子捲起義大利麵。

examples.en: This restaurant is famous for its authentic homemade spaghetti.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以道地的手工義大利麵聞名。

meaning: n. 香料, n. 情趣、風味, vt. 加香料於~, vt. 為~增添情趣、風味

examples.en: Cinnamon is a common spice used in baking.
examples.zh: 肉桂是烘焙中常用的香料。

examples.en: She spiced the soup with pepper and salt.
examples.zh: 她在湯裡加了胡椒和鹽來調味。

examples.en: They went on a surprise trip to add some spice to their marriage.
examples.zh: 他們來了一場驚喜之旅，為他們的婚姻增添情趣。

examples.en: Nutmeg is a popular spice used in many traditional recipes.
examples.zh: 肉豆蔻是許多傳統食譜中常用的熱門香料。

examples.en: She tries to spice up her daily routine by learning new hobbies.
examples.zh: 她試圖透過學習新嗜好來為日常作息增添情趣。

examples.en: Many wild animals starve to death during the harsh winter.
examples.zh: 在嚴酷的冬天裡，許多野生動物會餓死。

examples.en: The dictator deliberately starved the political prisoners.
examples.zh: 這位獨裁者故意將政治犯餓死。

examples.en: I’m so hungry I feel like I’m going to starve.
examples.zh: 我好餓，我覺得我快餓死了。

examples.en: Without food and water, the lost explorer would surely starve.
examples.zh: 沒有食物和水，迷路的探險家肯定會餓死。

examples.en: The long drought caused the cattle to starve in the fields.
examples.zh: 長期的乾旱導致牛隻在田野中餓死。

examples.en: When is dinner ready? I'm absolutely starving!
examples.zh: 晚餐什麼時候準備好？我快餓扁了！

examples.en: The charity provides food for starving children in poor areas.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構為貧困地區飢餓的兒童提供食物。

examples.en: They rescued a starving stray dog from the streets.
examples.zh: 他們從街上救了一隻挨餓的流浪狗。

examples.en: The starving refugees gratefully accepted the bread and water.
examples.zh: 飢餓的難民滿懷感激地接受了麵包和水。

examples.en: We rushed to the cafeteria because we were absolutely starving.
examples.zh: 我們衝向自助餐廳，因為我們實在快餓扁了。

examples.en: It took the climbers three days to reach the summit of the mountain.
examples.zh: 登山客花了三天時間才到達山峰。

examples.en: The world leaders gathered for an economic summit in Paris.
examples.zh: 各國領袖齊聚巴黎參加經濟高峰會。

examples.en: The view from the summit was absolutely breathtaking.
examples.zh: 從山頂看去的景色絕對令人嘆為觀止。

examples.en: The expedition team finally planted their flag at the summit.
examples.zh: 探險隊終於在山峰上插上了他們的旗幟。

examples.en: The upcoming summit will focus on environmental protection policies.
examples.zh: 即將舉行的高峰會將著重於環境保護政策。

meaning: 吊牌標籤；加上標籤、附上籤條；（在社群媒體上）標記

examples.en: The price tag on the jacket says it costs fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 夾克上的價格標籤寫著五十元。

examples.en: Don't forget to tag me in the photos you post online.
examples.zh: 別忘了在網路上發布的照片中標記我。

examples.en: Every piece of luggage needs to be tagged before the flight.
examples.zh: 每件行李在登機前都需要附上標籤。

examples.en: She forgot to remove the price tag before wrapping the gift.
examples.zh: 她在包裝禮物前忘了撕下價格標籤。

examples.en: The scientists tagged the wild dolphins to track their migration.
examples.zh: 科學家在野生海豚身上附上標籤以追蹤牠們的遷徙。

examples.en: My little brother always wants to tag along when I go out with friends.
examples.zh: 我和朋友出去時，我弟弟總是想要跟著去。

examples.en: Mind if I tag along? I have nothing else to do today.
examples.zh: 介意我跟著去嗎？我今天也沒什麼事做。

examples.en: She tagged along with us to the cinema, even though she wasn't invited.
examples.zh: 儘管沒被邀請，她還是跟著我們一起去電影院了。

examples.en: He decided to tag along when we went grocery shopping.
examples.zh: 當我們去買日常用品時，他決定跟著去。

examples.en: I don't mind if you tag along to the library.
examples.zh: 我不介意你跟著去圖書館。

examples.en: The tailor measured him carefully before making the suit.
examples.zh: 裁縫師在做西裝前仔細地為他量身。

examples.en: She brought her torn skirt to the local tailor to be fixed.
examples.zh: 她把破掉的裙子拿去給當地的裁縫師修補。

examples.en: He is an experienced tailor who can create any style of clothing.
examples.zh: 他是一位經驗豐富的裁縫，能製作任何款式的衣服。

examples.en: The royal tailor crafted an exquisite gown for the princess.
examples.zh: 皇家裁縫為公主製作了一件精美的禮服。

examples.en: My grandfather always went to the same tailor for his trousers.
examples.zh: 我爺爺總是去同一位裁縫那裡訂做褲子。

meaning: a. 訂做的、量身打造的

examples.en: The training program was tailor-made for new employees.
examples.zh: 這套培訓計畫是為新進員工量身打造的。

examples.en: He wore a tailor-made suit to his daughter's wedding.
examples.zh: 他穿了一套訂製的西裝參加女兒的婚禮。

examples.en: The travel agency offers tailor-made tours to suit your interests.
examples.zh: 這家旅行社提供量身打造的行程以迎合你的興趣。

examples.en: The software was tailor-made to meet the specific needs of our company.
examples.zh: 這套軟體是為滿足我們公司的特定需求而量身打造的。

examples.en: He proudly wore his newly arrived tailor-made jacket.
examples.zh: 他驕傲地穿著剛收到的訂做夾克。

examples.en: The kids used to tease him about his thick glasses.
examples.zh: 孩子們以前常拿他那副厚重的眼鏡取笑他。

examples.en: Don't get angry, I was only teasing you.
examples.zh: 別生氣，我只是在跟你開玩笑而已。

examples.en: She hates being teased about her height.
examples.zh: 她討厭別人拿她的身高來開玩笑。

examples.en: It's cruel to tease an animal that is locked in a cage.
examples.zh: 取笑被關在籠子裡的動物是很殘忍的。

examples.en: Her older brothers would constantly tease her about her crush.
examples.zh: 她的哥哥們經常拿她暗戀的對象來取笑她。

meaning: a. 溫柔的, a. (肉質) 軟嫩

examples.en: The steak was so tender that it melted in my mouth.
examples.zh: 這塊牛排非常軟嫩，入口即化。

examples.en: He kissed his wife on the forehead with tender affection.
examples.zh: 他滿懷溫柔愛意地親吻了妻子的額頭。

examples.en: She has a tender heart and often helps those in need.
examples.zh: 她有一顆柔軟的心，經常幫助有需要的人。

examples.en: The chicken was slow-cooked until it became perfectly tender.
examples.zh: 雞肉經過慢火燉煮，直到變得非常軟嫩。

examples.en: He sang a tender lullaby to help his daughter fall asleep.
examples.zh: 他唱了一首溫柔的搖籃曲，哄女兒入睡。

meaning: n. 溫柔、(肉質) 軟嫩

examples.en: The chef demonstrated how to achieve the perfect tenderness of the meat.
examples.zh: 主廚示範了如何讓肉質達到完美的軟嫩度。

examples.en: He looked at his newborn baby with extreme tenderness.
examples.zh: 他用極其溫柔的目光看著剛出生的寶寶。

examples.en: She spoke to the frightened puppy with great tenderness.
examples.zh: 她非常溫柔地對著那隻受驚的小狗說話。

examples.en: She was touched by the unexpected tenderness in his voice.
examples.zh: 他聲音中出乎意料的溫柔讓她很感動。

examples.en: The tenderness of this roasted beef is simply unbelievable.
examples.zh: 這塊烤牛肉的軟嫩度簡直令人難以置信。

meaning: a. (肉) 硬的, a. 困難的, a. 不屈的、強硬的

examples.en: The meat was so tough that I could barely chew it.
examples.zh: 這肉太硬了，我幾乎咬不動。

examples.en: It was a tough decision to leave my hometown and move abroad.
examples.zh: 離開家鄉搬到國外是個艱難的決定。

examples.en: The coach has a tough attitude during training sessions.
examples.zh: 教練在訓練期間態度非常強硬。

examples.en: Surviving in the desert requires a tough mindset and preparation.
examples.zh: 在沙漠中生存需要堅強的心智和準備。

examples.en: The boss is known for his tough negotiation skills.
examples.zh: 這位老闆以他強硬的談判技巧聞名。

meaning: n. 家教, vt. 擔任家教、(個別) 指導

examples.en: They hired a private tutor to help their son with his math homework.
examples.zh: 他們請了一位私人圖家教來幫兒子輔導數學作業。

examples.en: She tutors high school students in chemistry every weekend.
examples.zh: 她每個週末都指導高中生化學。

examples.en: Working as a tutor is a good way for college students to earn money.
examples.zh: 當家教是大學生賺錢的好方法。

examples.en: His former math tutor helped him pass the difficult entrance exam.
examples.zh: 他的前數學家教幫他通過了困難的入學考試。

examples.en: She volunteers to tutor disadvantaged children in the community.
examples.zh: 她自願為社區裡的弱勢兒童提供個別指導。

examples.en: Water is an uncountable noun in English grammar.
examples.zh: 在英文文法中，「水」是一個不可數名詞。

examples.en: You should use 'much' instead of 'many' with uncountable nouns.
examples.zh: 你應該將 'much' 而非 'many' 與不可數名詞連用。

examples.en: Abstract concepts like happiness are usually uncountable.
examples.zh: 像幸福這樣抽象的概念通常是不可數的。

examples.en: The concept of 'information' is considered an uncountable noun.
examples.zh: 「資訊」這個概念被視為不可數名詞。

examples.en: Words like 'music' and 'love' are usually uncountable.
examples.zh: 像「音樂」和「愛」這樣的詞彙通常是不可數的。

meaning: n. 蠟, vt. 塗、打蠟, vt. 熱蠟除毛

examples.en: The candle is made of natural beeswax.
examples.zh: 這根蠟燭是由天然蜂蠟製成的。

examples.en: He spent the afternoon washing and waxing his car.
examples.zh: 他花了一個下午洗車並為車子打蠟。

examples.en: She went to the salon to get her legs waxed before the beach trip.
examples.zh: 去海灘旅行前，她去美容院做了腿部熱蠟除毛。

examples.en: The floor was shining brightly after the janitor waxed it.
examples.zh: 工友打蠟後，地板閃閃發亮。

examples.en: She dripped some hot wax to seal the envelope completely.
examples.zh: 她滴了一些熱蠟將信封完全封住。

meaning: n. 雜草, vi./vt. 除草, vt. 剔除、淘汰

examples.en: My grandfather spends hours pulling out weeds in his garden.
examples.zh: 我爺爺花好幾個小時在花園裡拔雜草。

examples.en: It's hard work weeding the flower beds under the hot sun.
examples.zh: 在烈日下為花床除草是件苦差事。

examples.en: The company decided to weed out the poorly performing branches.
examples.zh: 這家公司決定淘汰表現不佳的分公司。

examples.en: The strict exam is designed to weed out unqualified applicants.
examples.zh: 這項嚴格的考試旨在淘汰不合格的申請者。

examples.en: The garden is overgrown with weeds and needs a lot of work.
examples.zh: 花園裡長滿了雜草，需要花很多功夫整理。

examples.en: The farmers are busy harvesting wheat in the fields.
examples.zh: 農民們正忙著在田裡收割小麥。

examples.en: Most bread is made from wheat flour.
examples.zh: 大多數的麵包都是用小麥麵粉製成的。

examples.en: A golden sea of wheat waved in the wind.
examples.zh: 金黃色的小麥海在風中搖曳。

examples.en: Whole wheat bread is generally considered healthier than white bread.
examples.zh: 全麥麵包通常被認為比白麵包更健康。

examples.en: The local economy relies heavily on the production of wheat.
examples.zh: 當地經濟嚴重依賴小麥的生產。

meaning: n. 口哨, n. 哨子, vi./vt. 吹口哨, vi./vt. 吹哨子

examples.en: The referee blew his whistle to indicate a foul.
examples.zh: 裁判吹響哨子示意犯規。

examples.en: He walked down the street whistling a happy tune.
examples.zh: 他吹著快樂的口哨走在街上。

examples.en: The train gave a loud whistle as it approached the station.
examples.zh: 火車進站時發出了一聲響亮的汽笛聲。

examples.en: The guard blew his whistle to warn the approaching hikers.
examples.zh: 守衛吹響哨子警告正在靠近的登山客。

examples.en: She taught her little brother how to whistle using his fingers.
examples.zh: 她教她弟弟如何用手指吹口哨。

examples.en: The wicked witch cast a spell on the innocent princess.
examples.zh: 邪惡的女巫對無辜的公主施了咒語。

examples.en: He had a wicked scheme to steal the company's money.
examples.zh: 他有一個偷取公司資金的邪惡陰謀。

examples.en: She gave me a wicked smile before walking away.
examples.zh: 她走開前給了我一個不懷好意的微笑。

examples.en: The knight fought bravely to defeat the wicked dragon.
examples.zh: 騎士英勇奮戰以打敗邪惡的龍。

examples.en: Spreading such false rumors is a truly wicked thing to do.
examples.zh: 散布這樣的虛假謠言真是一件邪惡的事。
